name: red-ghost-haute-couture
image_vibe: Moody deep-red haute couture with ghostly shutter-drag motion and dramatic glamour
image_purpose: Create a cinematic fashion editorial portrait and motion-effect key visual.

prompt.project_info: A high-fashion cinematic portrait of an original adult woman in a deep red monochromatic studio with a long-exposure ghosting effect.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with wavy auburn hair, fair natural skin with freckles, bold red lipstick, and a poised high-glance expression. She wears an elegant black velvet gown with a deep neckline and a statement ring, with one hand gracefully touching her neck.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered medium portrait with the subject sharp in the main exposure and a soft ghostly motion-blur trail extending to the right of her face. Keep the face and hand as focal points, with the black gown contrasting against the saturated red background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Saturated monochromatic deep-red lighting with high-contrast chiaroscuro, dramatic controlled shadows, a soft-focus vignette, and an ethereal but polished haute-couture atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, slow shutter-drag or long-exposure motion effect, high-resolution editorial photography, realistic velvet, skin, hair, and ring texture, controlled red color grade, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-fashion cinematic portrait of an original adult woman with wavy auburn hair, fair natural skin with freckles, bold red lipstick, and a poised high-glance expression. Dress her in an elegant black velvet gown with a deep neckline and a statement ring, with one hand gracefully touching her neck. Drench the scene in saturated monochromatic deep-red studio light with high-contrast chiaroscuro. Use a shutter-drag or long-exposure effect to create a ghostly ethereal motion-blur trail extending to the right of her face while keeping the main subject sharp. Frame a centered medium portrait with a soft-focus vignette, 35mm lens perspective, realistic velvet, skin, hair, and ring texture, subtle film grain, cinematic editorial polish, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, duplicated face, uncontrolled blur, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source red ghost haute couture portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for auburn hair, black velvet gown, saturated red light, neck-touch pose, and rightward shutter-drag effect; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult haute-couture subject, black velvet gown, auburn hair, red monochromatic light, statement ring, and rightward ghosting effect. Identity and non-essential studio details may vary.

changes: Clarified the subject as an original adult and retained the fashion silhouette with standard safety negatives.
